# scutum_user (Resource)

Manage a Scutum user account and role assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scutum_user" "ops_oncall" {
  username = "ops-oncall"
  password = var.ops_oncall_password
  roles    = ["developer"]
}

variable "ops_oncall_password" {
  description = "Initial password for the ops-oncall account"
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password — changes after creation are ignored (use the UI to rotate).
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `roles` (List of String) Role names to assign to this user (e.g. "admin", "developer").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
